description: Runs hybrid search then feeds the retrieved facts to a generator LLM that produces a citation-bearing answer (each claim ends with [factId]); a verifier LLM then judges whether every claim is supported. Three guardrail modes: strict (default) returns null on partial / unsupported / verifier outage (fail-closed); lenient returns the answer alongside the verifier verdict; off skips the verifier. Returns a direct natural-language answer rather than raw search results. Embedding model on this tenant: set per workspace.

asOf.description: Valid-time as-of: facts true at this ISO 8601 moment (not a knowledge snapshot)

limit.description: Top-K facts fed to the generator (default 10)

userId.description: Per-user memory scope: tenant-global plus this user's personal facts; omit for tenant-global only

name: synthesize
title: Synthesize a grounded answer from retrieved facts
